name: Pickle Ball Star
summary:
Pickle Ball Star brings the world’s fastest-growing sport into virtual reality!

Experience thrilling, realistic pickleball gameplay built in Unreal Engine 5 with dynamic physics, intuitive paddle control, and lifelike environments. Whether you’re rallying casually or playing competitive matches, Pickle Ball Star captures the energy, strategy, and fun of real pickleball.

Key Features:
🏓 Realistic paddle and ball physics for true-to-life gameplay
🤖 Smart AI opponents that adapt to your skill level
🧠 Prac
